root_cause: The existing original powerhouse_content_handoff_receipts_v1 correctly selected a Windsor provider-linked source_event_id from social_metric_snapshots but always populated measurement_consumer.measured_at from content_publication_obligations.measured_at. A source event from Nov 12 could therefore have a null or stale time even with accepted=true, masking the producer to consumer handshake.
impact: Proof mismatch and missing consumption-time evidence in original ONE BRAIN, with potential wrong heartbeat freshness, late learning, double treatment of metrics as unknown and misrouted next_action.
prevention: Select source_event_id and observed_at from the exact same independently account/post-linked snapshot row; reset at each post, copy that timestamp only when metric accepted. All other original channels retain their measured_at semantics. The BRAIN next action must be aligned with actual WAIT_ANALYSIS/OVERDUE_ANALYSIS stage while retaining the original source hint for provenance. All missing analysis/experiment outcomes stay OPEN.
